8.6.3.10 ClearDTC
[SWS_Dem_00666] Definition of ClientServerInterface ClearDTC ⌈
Name
ClearDTC
Comment
Provides a SWC interface to trigger a ClearDTC operation within the Dem. One port of this
interface type is provided globally by the Dem Service Component. It has ClientId as a
port-defined argument.
IsService
true
Variation
–
0
E_OK
Operation successful
